name: Maddening Power (Metapsionic)
body:
Your powers pollute the minds of those who experience them.

Benefit(s): To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. This feat can be applied only to mind-affecting powers that allow a Will save. If a target fails a Will save against the power, they take an amount of sanity damage equal to the number of power points spent on the power. If sanity is not used, the target takes an amount of damage to 1 mental ability score equal to half the number of power points spent on the power (minimum 1). Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. The power’s total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
